rotation: Actual DXGI DDI shim verifies cyclic kernel-handle changes, stable runtime handles, existing render-target view and bound-target updates, invalid-list atomicity, presentation using rotated allocation, and destruction without leaks. Shared runtime bookkeeping emulated explicitly outside UMD.
qualification_relationship: The provider implementation and NPU fixtures are unchanged between v80 and v81; v81 adds DXGI resource rotation and its CPU shim tests.
